name: Azure Cliff Modern Villa
author: Elena Rostova, AIA
notes: Luxury 2-story sustainable residential villa with panoramic glazing, double-height living room, open modular kitchen, and cantilevered terrace.

project_data.living_room: Spacious double-height living room with glass facade
project_data.dining_room: Open concept dining adjacent to terrace patio
project_data.kitchen: Modular island kitchen with integrated pantry
project_data.garden: Infinity pool deck and landscaped lawn

name: Zephyr Metro Cable-Stayed Bridge
author: Dr. Aris Thorne, PE
notes: 160m cable-stayed river crossing engineered with twin composite aerodynamic pylon towers, 4 vehicular traffic lanes, and integrated maintenance walkways.

floors.svg_blueprint:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 600" width="100%" height="100%" style="background:#090d16; border-radius:12px; font-family:'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;">
    <defs>
        <pattern id="brGrid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <path d="M 20 0 L 0 0 0 20" fill="none" stroke="#16233b" stroke-width="0.75" opacity="0.6"/>
        </pattern>
        <linearGradient id="waterGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0284c7" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0369a1" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <rect width="1000" height="600" fill="url(#brGrid)"/>

    <!-- TITLE & ENGINEERING STAMP -->
    <text x="40" y="42" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="1">CIVIL INFRASTRUCTURE: CABLE-STAYED GIRDER BRIDGE</text>
    <text x="40" y="62" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11">SPAN: 160.0 METERS • DECK WIDTH: 22.0 METERS • PIERS: 5 UNITS</text>

    <!-- SECTION 1: TOP PLAN VIEW (DECK) -->
    <g transform="translate(60, 90)">
        <text x="0" y="-12" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="700">▲ PLAN VIEW (ROADWAY DECK & TRAFFIC LANES)</text>
        <!-- Deck Base -->
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="880" height="90" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2" rx="4"/>
        <!-- Road Lanes -->
        <line x1="0" y1="22" x2="880" y2="22" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="8,6"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="45" x2="880" y2="45" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2.5"/> <!-- Centerline -->
        <line x1="0" y1="68" x2="880" y2="68" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="8,6"/>
        <!-- Pedestrian Barriers & Sidewalks -->
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="880" height="8" fill="#334155" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1"/>
        <rect x="0" y="82" width="880" height="8" fill="#334155" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="440" y="38" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">◄ LANE 1 & 2 (WESTBOUND) • LANE 3 & 4 (EASTBOUND) ►</text>
        <text x="890" y="48" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="9">WIDTH: 22.0m</text>
    </g>

    <!-- SECTION 2: LONGITUDINAL ELEVATION SECTION -->
    <g transform="translate(60, 270)">
        <text x="0" y="-14" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" font-weight="700">▲ LONGITUDINAL STRUCTURAL ELEVATION & PIER PROFILE</text>
        <!-- River / Water Body -->
        <rect x="80" y="160" width="720" height="60" fill="url(#waterGrad)" rx="6"/>
        <text x="440" y="196" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">RIVER / WATERWAY CHANNEL (HIGH WATER LEVEL)</text>

        <!-- Abutments at Left & Right -->
        <polygon points="0,70 80,70 80,180 0,220" fill="#334155" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text x="35" y="140" fill="#e2e8f0" font-size="9" font-weight="bold">ABUTMENT A1</text>

        <polygon points="800,70 880,70 880,220 800,180" fill="#334155" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <text x="815" y="140" fill="#e2e8f0" font-size="9" font-weight="bold">ABUTMENT A2</text>

        <!-- Horizontal Deck Girder -->
        <rect x="0" y="65" width="880" height="18" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2.5" rx="3"/>

        <!-- Concrete Piers & Piles -->
        
        <g id="pier_1">
            <!-- Pier Column -->
            <rect x="119.33333333333334" y="83" width="28" height="110" fill="#475569" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <!-- Elastomeric Bearings -->
            <rect x="123.33333333333334" y="80" width="20" height="4" fill="#f59e0b"/>
